Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
Fellow Methusalehs:

Extortion reads, in part, "Only usable when this vampire successfully
blocks (play after combat, if any)". I wanted to confirm my
understanding of this, and that is that the blocking vampire must
still be ready after combat (i.e. not in torpor, not burned).

I am a bit confused since the wording implies that this card can only
be "used" at the moment that the vampire successfully blocks, but must
be "played" after combat.

Thanks in advance,
Madman
